No scene, floor, shadows outside the object, labels, text, frames, line, hook, fish, characters, extra rods or floating particles. Delicate but clearly readable taper, grip occupies left 18%, compact functional reel mounted BELOW around 22%, six fine metal guides on the upper blank. Upper 65% remains a slim straight flexible fishing blank. Refined painterly realism, sharp constructed silhouette, exquisite material transitions, practical joints, deliberate silhouette hierarchy. Ornaments anchored to the lower third, not scattered gems. High fidelity edge highlights, subtle wear, intricate local detail with strong small-scale readability. No clipart, toy proportions, excessive bloom, oversized reel or disconnected components. Auspicious qilin: sculptural celadon-jade qilin head with branched deer antlers, curled lion mane, tiny gold carp scales and a pearl held in the mouth forms a compact reel socket. Antique gilt reel, dark moss-green brocade grip, muted jade-black tapered blank. Unmistakable noble mythical beast craftsmanship, mature museum-quality carved jade and worked gold.
